data.text: "Mera Safar ke sath hamara Andaman ka trip bilkul kamaal ka tha! Scuba diving ka arrangement aur hotel stays sab kuch premium tha. Koi hidden cost nahi li aur guide bhi bohot friendly tha."
data.name: Anjali Sharma

data.text: "Pondicherry ka French Riviera tour mind-blowing tha. Itinerary ka structure aur design itna perfect tha ki humne bina thake saari unique aur hidden places explore kar li. Recommended!"
data.name: Rahul Verma

data.text: "Varkala Cliff and Beach Escape was a hidden gem indeed. Mera Safar team ko 10/10 for their 24/7 customer support. Raat ko bhi hamari query ka unhone turant response diya."
data.name: Priya Rai
